The evidence does not, however, show a substantive extension or deepening in either direction: making different note/coin combinations is a partitioning/addition application under a separate Competency rather than a more complex form of reading and writing numerals, and same-rank placement means shared range wording, low-jaccard text/LC overlap ('99'), weak local-rank proximity, weak page proximity, and a coordinate-less shared CG ancestor cannot license buildsTowards. Symmetric relatesTo with null direction is therefore the supported judgment. Material limitations retained: both endpoints carry merge/duplicate-extraction audit context and truncated source evidence (32 omitted items each), and both Competencies and CG-1 lack developmental coordinates.

The shared token '99' alone was not treated as sufficient; the pair-specific range alignment plus the applied-money extension carries the judgment.
